ns2:section.sectionText: Description: This course examines the history of Latin America since independence, focusing on subjects such as the Cuban and Mexican Revolutions, cycles of dictatorship, and patterns of uneven economic development. We will look at experiences with slavery and emancipation, massive immigration, labor struggles, and women's movement. Latin American's history is interconnected with that of the United States. We will reflect on these connections with the United States as we explore the Americas' varied yet shared paths from colonies to nations.
